title: 14 Value 5: the ten-step scale, by eye

bites.title: No answer key
bites.body: The classic atelier exercise. Ten boxes, black to white, even steps. No reference row this time. Your eyes are the only meter.

bites.title: Paint the scale
bites.body: Use any method from lessons 10 to 13. Squint. Mirror ({key:mirror_canvas|M}) to check the steps feel even.
bites.praise: A real value scale. Frame it.

bites.title: 14 cleared
bites.body: If you can paint ten even steps, you can paint anything in black and white. Color is just value wearing a costume.
